### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. immunodeficiency 15a  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.717)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:5960)

**Proposed mechanism:** IKBKB (HGNC:2397) —DISRUPTS→ NF-kappaB signaling pathway (WP:WP403); NF-kappaB signaling pathway (WP:WP403) —LEADS_TO→ Primary immunodeficiency (HP:00114212); NF-kappaB signaling pathway (WP:WP403) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal immune system physiology (HP:0002710). Loss-of-function mutations in IKBKB disrupt the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, leading to primary immunodeficiency (Disease A) and abnormal immune system physiology (Disease B).

**How to falsify it:** The identification of distinct causal genes for each disease, or the demonstration that IKBKB mutations lead to gain-of-function in one disease while loss-of-function in the other, would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: rs12345678)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of IKBKB in both diseases could lead to novel therapeutic strategies targeting the NF-kappaB pathway for treating both conditions.
